parsed.justification: Rationale A correctly interprets the scoring rubric, identifying that the comment provides some support but lacks detailed elaboration on why the differences are minor. It accurately grounds its assessment in the text and avoids unsupported claims, warranting a score of 3 with appropriate justification. Rationale B overstates the justification quality by suggesting it 'aligns with the criteria for a high score,' while the rubric requires more than naming prior works—it demands clear reasoning about why the differences don't constitute significant novelty. B's claim that the justification is 'well-supported with specific examples' is partially inaccurate since the text doesn't provide detailed explanations of the differences, only naming them. However, B does correctly identify the referenced prior works and maintains appropriate grounding without making unwarranted claims.
